facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim went to get the ship back alone. He sailed a small boat at night. Two pirates were on the ship. Courage means doing right.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim made a bold plan to take back the Hispaniola by himself. He rowed a small boat across the dark water at night. Two pirates were guarding the ship, but Jim was determined. He climbed aboard quietly without making a sound. Courage means doing right. Jim's courage in that moment was truly remarkable.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Without telling anyone, Jim came up with an incredibly bold plan to recapture the ship. Under the cover of darkness, he paddled a tiny boat across the dangerous waters alone. The waves crashed against his small vessel, but Jim refused to turn back. When he reached the Hispaniola, he discovered two pirates standing guard on deck. Courage means doing right. However, Jim's determination was stronger than his fear of being caught. Because he moved silently and carefully, the pirates did not notice him climbing aboard. This was the most daring thing Jim had ever attempted in his entire life.
facts.Word cards: courage = 용기 / doing right = 옳은 일을 하기 / means = 의미한다 / definition = 정의
